about.heading: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm a business operations professional who evolved into applying technology and AI automation — not a developer who moved into business. My background is in advertising and business management, where I spent years structuring sales and operational processes for real companies, before I started applying AI and automation to solve those same problems.
about.paragraph2: I help turn a messy, manual sales or ops process into a working system: a CRM built around how the team actually sells, a dashboard that answers the questions leadership actually asks, or an AI layer that qualifies leads and follows up automatically. I work from understanding the problem all the way through delivery, with an operations and product lens, not a technical development-cycle one.
about.paragraph3: Before technology, it was years of hands-on advertising and business management, structuring sales process, service and operations for real companies. That's the operational lens I bring when I apply AI and automation: I start from the business problem, not the tech stack.
